summary: Backend testing for Auto-Pause & Trip Route Playback features on POST /api/rides/end. Ran /app/backend/tests/test_swoop_backend.py end-to-end (20 tests). 19/20 passed. Extended suite with 5 new tests covering route echo+rounding, thinning of large routes, malformed-element filtering, negative paused_seconds clamping, and backward-compat defaults. Renumbered delete-last-card test to test_19 so it stays last (deletes all cards). CRITICAL BUG FOUND: server-side route thinning does NOT reduce a 300-point route below 200 — remains at 300 points. Root cause is an off-by-one in the step calculation.

critical.issue: Route thinning fails for lengths in (200, 400]. Code uses `step = max(1, len(route) // 200)` then `route[::step]`. For len=300, step = 300//200 = 1 → route[::1] returns all 300 points, exceeding the documented 200-point cap. Fix: use ceil division, e.g. `step = max(2, math.ceil(len(route) / 200))` OR resample to exactly 200 via index math: `route = [route[i * (len(route) - 1) // 199] for i in range(200)]`. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:684-689.

action_items: Fix route thinning in /app/backend/server.py end_ride (~line 686): change `step = max(1, len(route) // 200)` to use ceil division so any input >200 is guaranteed thinned to <=200 (e.g. `step = max(1, math.ceil(len(route) / 200))` — for 300 pts step=2 → 150 pts; for 401 pts step=3 → 134 pts). Then rerun test_swoop_backend.py test_15.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py end_ride thinning uses integer floor division for stride, which allows lengths in (200, 400] to bypass the cap. Prefer ceil-based stride or a fixed-length downsample.

Test file test_swoop_backend.py existed pre-run and was extended in-place (per request). Suite runs under pytest-xdist -n 2 --dist loadscope; all TestSwoopFullFlow tests share one worker via a module-scoped fresh_user fixture — new tests were added inside the same class to preserve state ordering.

Positive: route echo rounds coords to 6 decimals correctly (test_14 pass), malformed inner lists (len<2) are filtered correctly (test_16 pass), negative paused_seconds clamped to 0 (test_17 pass), and defaults preserved when fields absent (test_18 pass).

rca_of_issue: RCA for route-thinning bug: In /app/backend/server.py POST /api/rides/end (~L684), when body.route length L>200, code computes `step = max(1, L // 200)` and slices `route[::step]`. Floor division yields step=1 for 200<L<400, so slicing is a no-op and the full L-point route is stored. Mitigation: replace with ceil-based stride `step = max(1, math.ceil(L / 200))` (math is already imported). Reproduction: POST /api/rides/end with route=300 points → response.route length == 300 (expected <=200). Verified via test_15_end_ride_thins_large_route_to_at_most_200_points.
